newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - H&Q cuts Biofield to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - H&Q cuts Biofield to hold.

text.p: --Hambrecht & Quist on Friday cut its recommendation on Biofield Corp to hold from buy in response to Thursday's rejection by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration of Biofield's premarket approval application for the Alexa breast cancer diagnosis device.

--said at $5 to $6 the stock likely discounts the risks associated with near-term events and has 100 percent upside if the FDA reverses its view and a downside of 30 percent to 40 percent if it does not.
--H&Q said it is confident Biofield can resolve its issues with the FDA.
--shares of Biofield were 5-1/2 lower at 5 on Nasadq in afternoon trading.
